n1.speaker: player
n1.text: (The front door closes at 2:13 a.m. Not loudly. Carefully.)

n2.speaker: player
n2.text: (Faelen stands on the step in full armor. Her room key is on the hall table. So is the star map, folded around a single black antler.)

n5.speaker: faelen
n5.text: The outriders gathered beneath the old transit station. Their bellwether is opening a path. If it completes the mark, the next surge begins under this district.

n7.speaker: faelen
n7.text: No. It followed my trail to this house. I remove the trail, or I remove what follows it.

n9.speaker: faelen
n9.text: That is how a Warden contains a breach.

n10.speaker: faelen
n10.text: You wanted the rest of the truth. Here it is: people near me die. This is my war. Not the house's.

choices.text: (Take the room key.) "Then you're not leaving this house to die."
(Hand her the room key.) "You forgot this. We go together."
(Step aside.) "I won't make the choice for you."

stop2.speaker: player
stop2.text: "No. You taught us to hold a line. This is mine."

stop3.speaker: faelen
stop3.text: If I stay, it comes here.

stop4.speaker: momo
stop4.text: Then it comes to all of us awake.

stop5.speaker: player
stop5.text: (Momo stands halfway down the stairs. Behind her, doors open. Nobody asks why they were not consulted.)

stop6.speaker: faelen
stop6.text: You should all be afraid of me.

join2.speaker: player
join2.text: "I heard every word. I reject your conclusion."

join3.speaker: faelen
join3.text: If you cross that threshold with me, I cannot promise to bring you back.

join4.speaker: player
join4.text: "Promise you'll let me fight for the chance."

join5.speaker: player
join5.text: (She closes your fingers around the room key. Her hand lingers there.)

join6.speaker: faelen
join6.text: Stay on my left. Do not chase the wound.

ready.speaker: player
ready.text: (The others gather behind you before either of you reaches the gate. Faelen looks at the party, then at the dark road ahead.)

ready2.speaker: faelen
ready2.text: Tight formation. We end this together.

release1.speaker: faelen
release1.text: I thought that was what I wanted.

release2.speaker: player
release2.text: (She takes the antler and leaves the key.)

release3.speaker: faelen
release3.text: Bar the northern window before dawn. They test the weak edges first.

release4.speaker: player
release4.text: (Her footsteps fade. For the first time since she arrived, nobody is watching the door.)
